result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off, making the content incomplete and inaccessible.

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated on the right edge. The restaurant name appears incomplete ('Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name) and the card extends beyond the visible viewport.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scrolling container or card width to ensure all visible cards are fully displayed. Consider implementing proper overflow handling or adjusting the card dimensions to fit the screen width while remaining fully viewable.
